theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Euclid P) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (L : NNReal), MeasurableSet M → Measurable f → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[n + 1] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ x, ‖G x‖ ≤ L) → (∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → AEMeasurable (fun t => ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t, ∫⁻ x in M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}, g x ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal ‖G x‖ * g x ∂μHE[n + 1]) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) → (∀ j, A j ⊆ M) → (∀ᵐ t, μHE[n] ((M \ ⋃ j, A j) ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0) → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ t, CountablyRectifiable n (A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), G x ≠ 0 ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (A j ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) x (T x ⊓ (ℝ ∙ G x)ᗮ)) → ∀ᵐ t, CountablyRectifiable n (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), G x ≠ 0 ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) x (T x ⊓ (ℝ ∙ G x)ᗮ)
